note: Public and publicly guaranteed (PPG) external debt stocks owed to official bilateral creditors, end of year, billion USD (IDS series DT.DOD.BLAT.CD by counterpart). Flow = creditor country -> debtor; flows kept for the 15 largest bilateral creditors in 2024 and stocks >= 0.05 bn. exports = total bilateral PPG debt owed to the creditor by IDS reporting countries (lent); imports = the debtor's total bilateral PPG debt (owed). Debtors are the ~120 low- and middle-income countries reporting to the World Bank DRS only. Lending by Chinese state banks booked as commercial (e.g. China Development Bank) is under private creditors and not included here.
